# Frosty Agent - Full Context

Frosty Agent is an AI customer agent designed to handle every enquiry before and after the sale. It deploys on websites and WhatsApp with a unified memory.

## Core Superpowers
- **WhatsApp Voice Notes:** Transcribes voice notes and replies in the same language.
- **Multilingual Support:** Handles 16 languages automatically.
- **AI PDF Quotations:** Generates personalized costing sheets and brochures.
- **24/7 Calendar Booking:** Directly checks availability and books site visits/appointments.
- **CRM Campaign Attribution:** Tags leads with their exact campaign source even on WhatsApp.
- **One Shared Memory:** A buyer who browsed the website on Monday does not start over when they message on WhatsApp on Thursday.

## Industry Expertise (35+ Verticals)

### 1. High-Ticket Quoters
Frosty is optimized for industries that rely on AI Quotations, CRM Campaign Attribution, and WhatsApp voice notes to close large deals.
- Real Estate Developers & Brokers
- Home Services (HVAC & Trades)
- Auto Dealerships
- Interior Design & Modular Kitchens
- Jewellery & Luxury Retail
- Manufacturing & Industrial B2B
- Building Materials & Distribution
- Solar & Renewables
- Equipment Rental & Heavy Machinery

### 2. The Appointment Engine
Frosty is optimized for 24/7 Appointment Booking, RAG Knowledge, and Human Handoff.
- Healthcare & General Clinics
- Dental Practices
- Med Spa & Dermatology
- IVF & Fertility Clinics
- Mental Health Therapy
- Law Firms & Legal
- Immigration & Visa Consultants
- Financial Advisors & Accounting
- Salons, Fitness & Yoga
- Diagnostics & Pathology Labs
- Veterinary Clinics
- Physiotherapy & Rehab

### 3. Education & Coaching
Frosty handles Multilingual Support, Lead Generation, and answering repetitive curriculum questions.
- Study Abroad & Overseas Education
- Coaching & Test Prep
- Private Schools & Daycares
- Higher Ed / Universities
- Individual Coaches & Consultants
- Corporate Training & Skill Development
- Professional Institutes & Certification Bodies

### 4. Volume Support (Travel & Commerce)
Frosty handles Follow-Up / Re-engagement, Order Status, and Conversational Commerce.
- E-Commerce & D2C
- Travel Agencies & Tours
- Hotels & Resorts
- Restaurants & Hospitality
- Insurance Agencies
- Logistics & Freight
- Event Management & Wedding Venues

## Pricing
Plans start at ₹5,299 a month in India and $199 internationally, with no setup or onboarding fee on any plan. Seven-day free trial, no card needed.
